newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Dec o/seas visitor arrivals to NZ exceed 200,000.
newsitem.headline: Dec o/seas visitor arrivals to NZ exceed 200,000.

text.p: The monthly number of overseas visitor arrivals to New Zealand exceeded 200,000 for the first time in December, Statistics New Zealand said on Tuesday.

At 208,330, the number of overseas visitors in December was 11 percent higher than the December 1995 total (187,220). After adjusting for seasonal variations, visitor numbers rose seven percent between November and December 1996.
Overseas visitor arrivals for the year ended December totalled 1.53 million, up nine percent on the previous December year's figure of 1.41 million.
The number of New Zealanders taking short trips overseas during December totalled 92,820, only 200 more than in December 1995.
During the year to December New Zealanders made 1.09 million short trips overseas, up 19 percent on the previous year.

The December month saw a net gain of 2,630 permanent and long term migrants, 670 fewer than the net gain in December 1995. The December year net gain was 24,830, down 13 percent on the December 1995 year.
